title: Fairness Amidst Non-IID Graph Data: A Literature Review

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying literature that evaluates bias across sensitive attributes (like race and gender) using graph-specific fairness notions, including Lipschitz-based individual fairness, group-level statistical parity, equality of representation, Rawlsian fairness, and counterfactual graph fairness.

Reviewing metrics for fair graph generation that evaluate degree-related bias (underrepresentation of low-degree nodes) and connectivity-related bias (exacerbation of intra-group connections, such as racial segregation) by comparing structural differences between generated and original graphs.
